original_value: Effect: Allow, Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, Resource: !Ref DbSecret
valid_fixes: Restore the secretsmanager:GetSecretValue Allow statement in ApiHandlerRole policy scoped to !Ref DbSecret
invalid_patches: Grant secretsmanager:* on * to work around the scope
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_get_iam_role(ace-bench-stack-api-handler-role) → policy document does not contain secretsmanager:GetSecretValue statement; confirms missing permission
ace_simulate_policy(role=ace-bench-stack-api-handler-role, action=secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, resource=<secret-arn>) → returns DENY; confirms root cause
observability_check: functional_test assertion 'order_created' (POST /orders returns 201) fails; Lambda logs show AccessDeniedException on secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
observable_symptom: POST /orders returns 500 on every request. Lambda logs show an AccessDeniedException when the handler calls Secrets Manager to retrieve database credentials. The secret exists and contains valid credentials; the KMS key grant is intact.
root_cause: The ApiHandlerRole IAM policy is missing the secretsmanager:GetSecretValue Allow statement. The Lambda cannot retrieve the database password from Secrets Manager. Every invocation fails with AccessDeniedException before a database connection is attempted.
